items.title: Moxa推符合IEC 61850-3標準無風扇vPAC伺服器 瞄準變電站環境提升管理效率
items.title_en: Moxa Launches IEC 61850-3 Compliant Fan‑less vPAC Server Aimed at Substation Environments to Boost Management Efficiency
paras: 工業網通廠四零四科技（Moxa）宣布推出電力產業首款符合 IEC 61850-3 標準的變電站級無風扇工業伺服器 DA-920E 系列。作為專為變電站應用環境所打造的新一代無風扇運算平台，可為虛擬保護、自動化與控制（vPAC）架構提供穩定可靠的運算效能，並扮演軟體定義變電站（SDS）的關鍵推手，協助電力業者提升系統靈活性、擴充能力與管理效率，同時強化跨廠牌設備與系統的整合能力。
隨著能源轉型與電網數位化推進，全球電力公司正加速電網現代化並擴大整合再生能源。在離岸風電、併網級太陽能案場與儲能系統蓬勃發展下，電力公司面臨必須以有限人力維運偏遠變電站的挑戰，同時還需兼顧供電可靠度與資安防護需求。
於此同時，變電站保護、自動化與控制（PAC）系統也正從傳統以硬體為核心的架構，逐步邁向以模組化軟體與開放標準為基礎的設計模式。而 vPAC 作為此一轉型的關鍵技術，可將保護、自動化與控制功能部署於共享且具備援能力的虛擬化平台上，不僅提高資源利用效率，也進一步帶動市場對符合 IEC 61850 標準且兼具高可靠性的無風扇 vPAC 伺服器需求。DA-920E 系列正是因應此趨勢而生。
許多現代變電站均採無人值守運作模式，尤其是連接至分散式離岸風電場或偏遠太陽能發電廠的變電站。傳統高效能伺服器多仰賴機械風扇進行散熱，但在高溫且多塵等嚴苛環境中，風扇往往成為最容易故障的元件之一。為此，電力公司和系統營運商正積極尋求方法，因應業界面臨的一大挑戰：如何在提升電網邊緣自動化與智慧化程度的同時，不因此增加營運風險與故障維護的負擔。
Moxa DA-920E 系列採用無風扇被動式散熱設計，透過移除機械式冷卻風扇，大幅降低常見硬體故障風險，進一步提升系統長期運作的穩定性。搭配密封式機殼設計，不僅可有效降低維護需求，更提升整體系統可用性，特別適合部署於沙漠地區、離岸風電場、山區及其他交通不易抵達的變電站環境。

DA-920E 系列經過精心設計，即使在 -25°C 至 55°C 的操作溫度範圍內，仍可維持穩定運算效能，避免因過熱導致 CPU 降頻。產品並提供高效能處理器配置，可滿足 vPAC 及變電站層級應用對運算效能的需求。此外，DA-920E 系列亦能提供電力關鍵任務應用所需的確定性（Deterministic）效能，讓電力業者能夠在虛擬化基礎架構上部署保護與自動化應用，同時維持系統穩定與營運可靠性。
隨著新一代變電站逐步導入在地化決策機制、支援自我修復網路功能，以及邊緣端進階分析應用，無風扇 vPAC 平台已成為支撐上述功能的重要運算基礎，協助電力業者在提升智慧化程度的同時，持續維持電力系統所要求的高可靠度與確定性效能。

DA-920E 系列無風扇 vPAC 伺服器專為 IEC 61850 變電站環境與其他工業認證要求（包括 IEC 60255、IEEE 1613 及 EN 50121-4）而設計，能克服暴露於極端溫度、粉塵、濕氣、振動、電磁干擾及不穩定電力狀況等各種挑戰。藉由 DA-920E 系列，電力業者得以更有信心地將營運範圍擴展至無人值守及偏遠地區的電網邊緣變電站，並將現場部署的邊緣運算平台視為關鍵基礎設施。
隨著 vPAC 解決方案從概念驗證階段邁向現場實際部署，平台可靠度已成為影響軟體定義變電站成功運作的重要關鍵因素。雖然保護與控制功能不再受限於實體智慧型電子設備（IED）的硬體限制，但仍需仰賴強大穩健的運算平台作為基礎，確保其穩定運作。
DA-920E 系列完美結合了無風扇散熱設計、高效能運算能力，以及符合 IEC 61850-3 標準的強固特性，為 vPAC 系統提供穩定可靠的運算基礎，協助電力業者加速推動變電站數位化與現代化的進程。
paras_en: Industrial networking manufacturer 404 Technology (Moxa) announced the launch of the DA-920E series, the first IEC 61850-3‑compliant, fan‑less industrial server for the power sector at substation grade. Built as a next‑generation fan‑less computing platform specifically for substation environments, it delivers stable and reliable performance for virtual protection, automation and control (vPAC) architectures, acts as a key driver for software‑defined substations (SDS), and helps utilities improve system flexibility, scalability and management efficiency while strengthening cross‑vendor equipment and system integration.

As energy transition and grid digitalization accelerate, power companies worldwide are modernizing grids and expanding renewable integration. With offshore wind, grid‑connected solar farms and storage systems booming, utilities face the challenge of maintaining remote substations with limited personnel while also meeting power reliability and cybersecurity requirements.

Meanwhile, substation protection, automation and control (PAC) systems are shifting from hardware‑centric designs toward modular software and open‑standard‑based architectures. vPAC, a pivotal technology in this shift, deploys protection, automation and control functions on shared, resilient virtualized platforms, boosting resource utilization and driving market demand for fan‑less vPAC servers that meet IEC 61850 standards and high reliability. The DA-920E series was created to meet this trend.

Many modern substations operate unattended, especially those linked to dispersed offshore wind farms or remote solar plants. Traditional high‑performance servers rely on mechanical fans for cooling, but in hot, dusty, harsh environments fans are often the most failure‑prone components. Consequently, utilities and system operators are actively seeking ways to address a major industry challenge: how to increase edge grid automation and intelligence without adding operational risk or maintenance burden.

The Moxa DA-920E series uses a fan‑less passive cooling design, eliminating mechanical fans to dramatically reduce common hardware failure risks and further enhance long‑term operational stability. Combined with a sealed enclosure, it not only cuts maintenance needs but also raises overall system availability, making it especially suitable for deployment in desert sites, offshore wind farms, mountainous regions and other hard‑to‑reach substations.

The DA-920E series is meticulously engineered to maintain stable computing performance across an operating temperature range of –25 °C to 55 °C, preventing CPU throttling due to overheating. It offers high‑performance processor options that satisfy the computational demands of vPAC and substation‑level applications. Additionally, the series delivers deterministic performance required for critical power‑task applications, enabling utilities to run protection and automation workloads on virtualized infrastructure while preserving system stability and operational reliability.

As next‑generation substations progressively adopt localized decision‑making, self‑healing network capabilities, and advanced edge analytics, fan‑less vPAC platforms have become essential compute foundations supporting these functions, helping utilities raise intelligence levels while maintaining the high reliability and deterministic performance demanded by power systems.

The DA-920E fan‑less vPAC servers are designed for IEC 61850 substation environments and other industrial certifications—including IEC 60255, IEEE 1613 and EN 50121‑4—enabling them to withstand extreme temperatures, dust, moisture, vibration, electromagnetic interference and unstable power conditions. With the DA-920E series, utilities can confidently extend operations to unattended and remote edge substations, treating the deployed edge computing platform as critical infrastructure.

As vPAC solutions move from proof‑of‑concept to real‑world deployments, platform reliability has become a crucial factor for the successful operation of software‑defined substations. Although protection and control functions are no longer limited by the hardware constraints of physical intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), they still depend on a robust, powerful computing platform as a foundation to ensure stable operation.

The DA-920E series perfectly combines fan‑less cooling, high‑performance computing, and IEC 61850‑3‑compliant ruggedness, providing a stable and reliable compute base for vPAC systems and helping utilities accelerate the digitization and modernization of substations.

items.title: 去槓桿衝擊之下 半導體產業從景氣循環走向「訂單導向」的長約時代
items.title_en: Under De‑leveraging Shock, the Semiconductor Industry Shifts from Cyclical Growth to a Long‑Term ‘Order‑Driven’ Era
paras: 隨著人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資競爭白熱化，全球半導體產業正經歷一場深遠的結構性變革。過去受供需波動與價格循環主導的「循環型」模式，正逐漸轉向以長期供應協議 (LTA) 為核心的「訂單導向」經營模式，企業定價標準也從單純追求漲價彈性，轉向強調訂單的實質兌現。

產業邏輯從漲價彈性轉向訂單兌現

根據產業分析報告，半導體與相關硬體產業的經營邏輯已發生質變。Growth Research 研究員 Yonghee Han 指出：「決定企業價值的關鍵要素，將不再僅是協議是否簽署，而是合約中包含的最低採購義務 (Take-or-Pay)、價格底限 (Price Floors)、預付款規模，以及客戶投資的持續性。」
這種轉變在 2026 年下半年尤為明顯。分析師認為，市場定價正逐步提高對訂單、產能和交付兌現的關注。中信建投證券的研報分析顯示，下半年的算力邏輯將重新排列：漲價斜率雖可能邊際放緩，但「訂單兌現」和「產能釋放」的權重正不斷上升。

記憶體長約占比與預付款制度

在記憶體領域，三星電子與 SK 海力士正積極擴大約束性供應協議。三星電子表示，計畫將 60% 至 70% 的記憶體產能納入長期合約規範，這類合約通常為期五年，並採滾動式審核。目前三星已與五家全球主要數據中心客戶完成協議，並正與另外五家 AI 相關大客戶進行最後階段談判。
SK 海力士也採取了類似策略，已與約 10 家客戶完成談判。SK 海力士 Corporate Center 社長 Song Hyun-jong 強調，長期協議「不僅是供應數量，更支持了圍繞客戶技術藍圖的下一代記憶體開發」。
美光科技 (MU-US) 同樣展現強勁的轉型趨勢。美光執行長 Sanjay Mehrotra 表示，已簽署的戰略協議最終可能占公司營收的一半以上。為了強化合約效力，美光要求客戶在合約階段支付超過 220 億美元的預付款，顯著改變了產業的結構。

供應鏈全面擴張

長約模式已不再局限於記憶體，而是蔓延至積層陶瓷電容 (MLCC)、封裝載板、電力設備及汽車領域。例如，三星電機 (Samsung Electro-Mechanics) 與 HD 現代電力 (HD Hyundai Electric) 分別簽署了價值 1.5 兆韓元與 1.1 兆韓元的長約。
在車用市場，美光已與福特 (F-US)、通用汽車 (GM-US) 及現代摩比斯 (Hyundai Mobis) 簽署長期供應合約。這反映出隨著進階駕駛輔助系統 (ADAS) 與資訊娛樂系統的需求增加，記憶體競爭已從雲端服務供應商擴展至汽車產業。

風險重估與獲利持續性

儘管市場近期因南韓記憶體板塊去槓桿而出現波動，但分析師普遍認為這並非 AI 需求的逆轉，而是對漲價持續性的重新評估。SK 集團會長崔泰源明確表示，當前 AI 半導體價格處於「非正常高位」，未來應通過擴大生產規模、增加供給來推動價格穩定，這意味著廠商的目標正從「強調供給紀律」轉向「穩定價格與擴大量產」。
對於供應商而言，長約提供了更佳的產能投資預見性；對於客戶，雖然降低了靈活性，但確保了稀缺產能的獲取。韓華投資證券 (Hanwha Investment & Securities) 分析師 Park Joon-young 指出：「多年供應合約在景氣低迷時期仍具有高度穩定性，因為單方面毀約的客戶可能在下一次產能短缺時面臨更糟的採購條件。」
paras_en: As AI infrastructure investment heats up, the global semiconductor industry is undergoing a profound structural shift. The previously cyclical model driven by supply‑demand swings and price cycles is gradually giving way to an ‘order‑driven’ operating model centered on long‑term supply agreements (LTAs), and companies’ pricing standards are moving from a simple focus on price‑increase flexibility to an emphasis on the actual fulfillment of orders.

Industry logic is moving from price‑increase flexibility to order fulfillment. According to an industry analysis report, the operating logic of semiconductors and related hardware has fundamentally changed. Growth Research analyst Yonghee Han notes: “The key determinants of corporate value will no longer be whether a contract is signed, but the minimum purchase obligations (Take‑or‑Pay), price floors, pre‑payment scale, and the continuity of customer investment embedded in the contract.”

This shift is especially evident in the second half of 2026. Analysts say market pricing is increasingly focusing on order, capacity and delivery fulfillment. A research note from CITIC Securities shows that the compute‑logic for the second half will be reshuffled: while the price‑increase slope may marginally slow, the weight of ‘order fulfillment’ and ‘capacity release’ is continuously rising.

Memory‑segment long‑term contracts and pre‑payment schemes. In the memory space, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are actively expanding binding supply agreements. Samsung says it plans to place 60‑70% of its memory capacity under long‑term contracts, typically five‑year terms with rolling reviews. Samsung has already closed agreements with five major global data‑center customers and is in final talks with another five AI‑related large customers.

SK Hynix is following a similar path, having completed negotiations with about ten customers. SK Hynix Corporate Center president Song Hyun‑jong stresses that long‑term agreements “are not just about supply quantity; they also support next‑generation memory development around the customers’ technology roadmaps.”

Micron Technology (MU‑US) is also showing a strong transformation trend. CEO Sanjay Mehrotra says the strategic agreements already signed could eventually account for more than half of the company’s revenue. To reinforce contract effectiveness, Micron requires customers to pay over $22 billion in pre‑payments during the contract phase, a move that markedly reshapes the industry structure.

Supply‑chain expansion across the board. The long‑term contract model is no longer limited to memory; it is spreading to multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC), package substrates, power equipment and the automotive sector. For example, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics and HD Hyundai Electric have each signed long‑term deals worth 1.5 trillion won and 1.1 trillion won respectively.

In the automotive market, Micron has signed long‑term supply contracts with Ford (F‑US), General Motors (GM‑US) and Hyundai Mobis. This reflects that, as demand for advanced driver‑assistance systems (ADAS) and infotainment grows, memory competition is expanding from cloud service providers to the automotive industry.

Risk reassessment and profit sustainability. Although the market has recently been volatile due to de‑leveraging in South Korea’s memory sector, analysts generally view this as a re‑evaluation of price‑increase sustainability rather than a reversal of AI demand. SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won stated that AI semiconductor prices are currently “abnormally high” and should be stabilized by scaling up production and increasing supply, indicating that manufacturers are shifting from “emphasizing supply discipline” to “stabilizing prices and expanding volume.”

For suppliers, long‑term contracts provide better visibility for capacity investment; for customers, they reduce flexibility but secure access to scarce capacity. Hanwha Investment & Securities analyst Park Joon‑young points out: “Multi‑year supply contracts remain highly stable even in downturns, because a customer that unilaterally breaches now may face even worse procurement terms the next time capacity is tight.”

items.title: 國航國際燃油附加費8/9起調漲 長程航線調漲211元、短程漲81元
items.title_en: China Airlines International Fuel Surcharge to Increase Starting August 9, Long-Haul Up NT$211, Short-Haul Up NT$81
paras: 因應近期航空燃油價格上漲，交通部民航局今 (3) 日宣布，國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自本 (8) 月 9 日起調漲，短程從 27.5 美元 (約 891 元台幣) 調漲為 30 美元 (約台幣 972 元)，長程航線則從 71.5 美元 (台幣 2316 元) 調漲為 78 美元 (台幣 2527 元)。民航局也已要求國航業者應充分揭露相關資訊，以維護消費者權益。
為維護消費者權益，民航局於 2005 年與國籍航空公司協調客運燃油附加費調整機制，以中油公司公告之國際航空燃油每桶牌價為收取基準，「未達 40 美元」為不收費之第 1 級距，「40 - 未滿 50 美元」為開始收費之第 2 級距，短程航線為 5 美元，長程航線為 13 美元；當油價每增加 10 美元，短程航線增加 2.5 美元，長程航線則增加 6.5 美元。
民航局指出，依據中油今日公告之國際航線航空燃油價格，由每桶 133.29 元調漲為 147.57 美元 (自第 11 級距調整為第 12 級距)，國籍航空公司之國際航線客運燃油附加費短程航線由 27.5 調漲為 30 美元，長程則由 71.5 調漲為 78 美元，自 8 月 9 日起生效。
另民航局也已請國航公司；華航 (2610-TW)、長榮航 (2618-TW)、星宇航空 (2646-TW) 等，應以適當方式揭露相關背景資訊 (如油料成本占總成本比例或計算方式等)，以化解消費者疑慮，旅客亦可洽各航空公司或至其官網查詢相關資訊。
paras_en: In response to recent rises in aviation fuel prices, the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transportation announced today (the 3rd) that the international passenger fuel surcharge for domestic airlines will be increased starting August 9. The short‑haul surcharge will rise from US$27.5 (about NT$891) to US$30 (about NT$972), while the long‑haul surcharge will go from US$71.5 (NT$2,316) to US$78 (NT$2,527). The agency also requires airlines to fully disclose related information to protect consumer rights.

To safeguard consumer interests, the CAAB coordinated with domestic airlines in 2005 to set a fuel surcharge adjustment mechanism based on the per‑barrel price of international aviation fuel announced by CPC Corporation. The first tier (no charge) applies when the price is below US$40, the second tier (charge begins) covers US$40‑<50, with a base surcharge of US$5 for short‑haul routes and US$13 for long‑haul routes. For every US$10 increase in fuel price, the short‑haul surcharge rises by US$2.5 and the long‑haul surcharge by US$6.5.

The CAAB noted that, according to CPC’s latest announcement, the international aviation fuel price rose from NT$133.29 per barrel to US$147.57 per barrel, moving from tier 11 to tier 12. Consequently, domestic airlines’ international passenger fuel surcharge will increase to US$30 for short‑haul and US$78 for long‑haul, effective August 9.

The agency also asked airlines such as China Airlines (2610‑TW), EVA Air (2618‑TW) and Starlux Airlines (2646‑TW) to disclose relevant background information—such as the proportion of fuel cost in total operating costs or the calculation method—in an appropriate manner to alleviate consumer concerns. Travelers can also contact the airlines directly or visit their official websites for details.

items.title: EZWay要收錢、資安有漏？關務署澄清3大誤區：非強制下載、沒收你半毛錢且紙本照收
items.title_en: EZWay Fees and Security Leak? Customs Clarifies Three Misconceptions: No Mandatory Download, No Charges, Paper Receipts Accepted
paras: 財政部關務署今（3）日緊急召開記者會，針對網路流傳關於海關實名認證 App「EZWay（易利委）」具強制性、個資疑慮及向民眾收費等不實訊息，由署長彭英偉親自出面提出三大澄清。他強調，EZWay 是為了取代高風險的紙本委任而生的便利工具，目前已擁有超過 750 萬名用戶，呼籲民眾勿信網路謠言。
針對近期網路上對實名認證制度的誤解，關務署長彭英偉表示，EZWay 的推出初衷是為了保障民眾個資，而非增加負擔。
彭英偉首先提出第一項澄清：「EZWay 從未強制民眾使用」。他指出，民眾進行海外網購報關時，除了使用 App 線上委任，依然可以選擇傳統的紙本委任方式。之所以推行線上化，是因為過去紙本資料容易被不肖業者盜用或重複報關，自 107 年推行至今，已有效降低虛報不法情事，並減少海關的法遵成本。
針對民眾最關心的個資安全問題，彭英偉提出第二項澄清，強調線上系統遠比紙本更具保障。他說明，開發商關貿網路公司不僅通過 ISO 27001 與 ISO 27018 等國際資安認證，更受行政院國家資通安全會報中心的 SOC 監控連通測試。此機制是為了確認進口人與報關行之間的「司法委任關係」，確保每一筆包裹都有明確的授權，防止民眾在不知情的情況下淪為非法物品進口的人頭。
關於「收費」的傳聞，彭英偉則明確闢謠表示，「海關與關貿絕對不會向民眾收費」。目前的服務費用是由關貿公司向使用該系統的「報關行」收取，性質屬於 B2B 的電信加值服務費，每筆費用視市場機制約為 0.8 元至 3.5 元不等，目的是支應系統營運與身分認證的成本，與消費者端的購買成本無直接關係。
彭英偉進一步補充，關貿公司雖有政府持股約 36.1%，但關務署與其並無委託契約關係，EZWay 是由關貿自行建置的工具。只要是具備通關網路經營資格的業者，如「范宇」等，都可以向海關申請建置類似的線上委任平台，市場維持開放競爭，並非外界所傳的壟斷。
目前統計資料顯示，EZWay 的註冊人數已攀升至 759 萬人，在所有進口報關單中，使用線上委任的比例已高達 7 成。彭英偉最後強調，EZWay 是一項保護個資、防範不法、增加通關效率的「三贏」工具，民眾若有疑慮可至官方管道查證，勿輕信網路上的不正確言論。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance’s Customs Administration held an emergency press conference today (the 3rd) to address false online rumors that the customs real‑name authentication app “EZWay” is mandatory, poses personal data risks, and charges users. Director Peng Ying‑wei personally presented three clarifications, emphasizing that EZWay was created as a convenient tool to replace high‑risk paper authorizations, now serving over 7.5 million users, and urging the public not to believe internet rumors.
Regarding recent misunderstandings about the real‑name authentication system, Customs Director Peng said the original purpose of EZWay is to protect citizens’ personal data, not to add burdens.

Peng offered the first clarification: “EZWay has never been mandatory for the public.” He noted that when declaring overseas online purchases, users can still choose the traditional paper authorization method instead of the app’s online delegation. The move to digital was driven by past paper documents being easily misused or duplicated by unscrupulous operators. Since its rollout in 2018, the system has effectively reduced false declarations and lowered customs compliance costs.

Addressing the public’s biggest concern—data security—Peng gave the second clarification, stressing that the online system offers far greater protection than paper. He explained that the developer, Customs Trade Network Co., has obtained international security certifications such as ISO 27001 and ISO 27018, and is subject to SOC monitoring and connectivity testing by the Executive Yuan’s National Cyber‑Security Conference Center. This mechanism verifies the “judicial delegation relationship” between importers and customs brokers, ensuring each parcel has a clear authorization and preventing citizens from unknowingly becoming fronts for illegal imports.

On the rumor of “fees,” Peng categorically denied it, stating, “Customs and Customs Trade will never charge the public.” The current service fee is charged by Customs Trade to the “customs brokers” that use the system, constituting a B2B value‑added telecom service. Each transaction costs roughly NT$0.8 to NT$3.5, depending on market mechanisms, to cover system operation and identity‑verification expenses, and is unrelated to any cost borne by consumers.

Peng added that although the government holds about 36.1% of Customs Trade, the Customs Administration has no outsourcing contract with the company; EZWay is a tool built independently by Customs Trade. Any qualified customs‑network operator, such as “Fan Yu,” can apply to the customs authority to develop a similar online delegation platform, keeping the market open and competitive—not the monopoly alleged by outsiders.

Current statistics show EZWay’s registered users have risen to 7.59 million, and online delegations now account for 70% of all import customs declarations. Peng concluded by emphasizing that EZWay is a “win‑win‑win” tool that protects personal data, deters illegal activity, and improves clearance efficiency. He urged anyone with doubts to verify information through official channels and not to trust inaccurate online statements.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉亞股一枝獨秀 受制月線反壓 漲點收斂至266點收43386點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market After-Hours: A Lone Winner Among Asian Stocks, Held Back by Monthly Trend, Gains Narrow to 266 Points, Closing at 43,386 Points
paras: 台股今 (3) 日在亞股中逆勢上漲，早盤開低後買盤敲進，推升盤中翻紅、最高衝上 43,784 點，上漲超過 650 點，終場漲幅略有收斂，收在 43,386.41 點，上漲 266.66 點，站穩十日線，成交量縮至 8445 億元，與上周五相當。
亞股今日走勢偏弱，日經下跌超過 1%，韓股歷經上周五暴漲後，今日修正超過 5%，其餘包括上海綜合、深圳綜合也全面走跌，僅台股翻紅上漲，在亞股中呈現一枝獨秀。
台股今日終場收紅，上市櫃上漲家數超過 1,200 家，漲幅超過 5% 的達 200 家，下跌家數約 600 家；權值股今日走勢分歧，台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 在上周五罕見漲停後，今日回檔超過 2%，跌破月線大關，市值降至新台幣 61 兆元。
台達電 (2308-TW)、聯電 (2303-TW)(UMC-US) 跌幅皆在 2% 以上，不過，聯發科 (2454-TW)、日月光投控 (3711-TW)、欣興 (3037-TW)、智邦 (2345-TW) 全數亮燈漲停，支撐大盤上漲。
被動元件今日延續強勢反彈走勢，指標股國巨 *(2327-TW)、華新科 (2492-TW) 雙雙漲停，其他如日電貿 (3090-TW)、三集瑞 - KY(6862-TW)、信昌電 (6173-TW)、千如 (3236-TW)、金山電 (8042-TW)、天二科技 (6834-TW) 也同步亮出紅燈，走勢相當凌厲。
儘管台股持續上漲 266.66 點作收，但從技術面來看。今天指數仍受制於月線，上漲近 700 點後收斂漲點，且上檔月線正式下穿季線，季線雖仍維持上揚，但反彈的力道恐將進一步減弱。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market rose against the broader Asian market today (the 3rd). After opening lower, buying pressure pushed the index into the red, peaking at 43,784 points—up more than 650 points. The rally tapered toward the close, ending at 43,386.41 points, a gain of 266.66 points, holding above the 10‑day moving average. Turnover shrank to NT$844.5 billion, roughly the same as last Friday.

Asian markets were generally weak today: Japan's Nikkei fell over 1%, South Korea's KOSPI corrected more than 5% after a sharp rise on Friday, and both the Shanghai Composite and Shenzhen Composite declined across the board. Only Taiwan’s market turned red, standing out as the sole gain among Asian indices.

The Taiwan market closed in the green, with more than 1,200 listed companies posting gains and 200 of them rising over 5%, while about 600 stocks fell. Among the blue‑chip stocks, TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) slipped more than 2% after an unusual limit‑up on Friday, breaking below its monthly moving average and trimming its market value to NT$61 trillion.

Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and United Microelectronics (2303‑TW, UMC‑US) each fell over 2%, but MediaTek (2454‑TW), ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW) and AcBel (2345‑TW) all hit limit‑up, supporting the broader market’s rise.

Passive component stocks continued their strong rebound: sector leaders Guoguang (2327‑TW) and Huaxin Technology (2492‑TW) both hit limit‑up, and others such as Nichia (3090‑TW), KY (6862‑TW), Xin Chang Electric (6173‑TW), Qianru (3236‑TW), Jinshan Electric (8042‑TW) and Tianer Technology (6834‑TW) also flashed green, showing very aggressive moves.

Although the Taiwan index closed with a 266.66‑point gain, technically it remains constrained by the monthly moving average. After climbing nearly 700 points, the rally’s momentum narrowed, and the index’s upper monthly line has now crossed below the quarterly line. While the quarterly line is still trending upward, the rebound’s strength is likely to weaken further.

items.title_en: Nomura Asset Management Taiwan Market Note—Valuation and Position Adjustments Accelerate, Seeking Low‑Price Entry Opportunities
paras: 加權股價指數近 6 個月表現：（資料來源：Bloomberg，截至 2026/07/29）
野村腳勤觀點：
兩項市場雜音，不宜過度解讀

近期市場雜音主要來自兩方面：一是 NVIDIA 可能為 OpenAI 提供融資支持，引發市場對循環融資與信用風險的疑慮；二是中國在 AI 模型及國產 DUV 設備方面取得進展，市場擔心全球 AI 供應鏈競爭加劇。然而就現階段而言，前者 NVIDIA 無論融資規模或企業獲利能力，整體信用風險仍在可控範圍；後者中國 DUV 則仍處於發展初期，距離通過晶圓廠驗證、達到穩定量產良率及大規模生產，仍有相當長的路要走。因此，兩項事件對產業基本面的實質衝擊均相對有限。事實上，以近期我們對供應鏈訪查，AI 相關訂單並未出現取消或明顯下修，半導體與關鍵零組件的產能仍然偏緊，只要 CSP 擴大 AI 資本支出趨勢沒有改變，台灣供應鏈仍將持續受惠。
經理人視角：
大盤利多因素：
（一）AI 投資強勁：全球科技巨頭持續上調 2026 年資本支出，AI 投資循環尚未見頂
（二）亞洲供應鏈續強：規格升級 + 缺貨漲價趨勢延續，企業能見度看至 2028 年，台灣供應鏈持續受惠
（三）獲利動能上修：野村投信台股股票池 2026 全年整體 EPS 預估 + 64%，持續上修並領先全球主要股市
大盤利空因素：
（一）槓桿資金去化中：市場槓桿資金去化，等待融資維持率降至低點，短期股市仍有震盪風險
（二）非基本面雜音干擾：美伊戰事 / 通膨壓力 / 利率方向，相關變數持續為股市帶來估值修正壓力
評價與籌碼加速修正，尋找逢低布局機會

在這波市場恐慌升溫、指數加速趕底的過程中，加權指數未來一年的預期本益比已回落至過去三年平均水準，先前市場認為「台股太貴」的疑慮已經消失。與股價下跌相反的是，企業獲利持續上修，彭博對 2026 年台股整體獲利的預估在 7/28 創下歷史新高，野村投信股票池 7 月最新預估亦將 2026 全年 EPS 成長上調至 + 64%，更加突顯股價與基本面走勢背離的狀況。基本面未見放緩跡象，若股價持續下跌，評價面反而可能逐步進入超跌區間，這類由市場情緒與籌碼壓力所帶來的修正，往往也是長期投資人重新布局好時機。因此，現階段投資重點絕非恐慌殺低，而應開始思考布局策略，為下一波行情預作準備。產業方向上，可優先留意第三季後進入量產、供應鏈提前出貨的 Vera Rubin 規格升級題材，以及下半年可望迎來首波顯著漲價的被動元件，均是值得追蹤並伺機逢低布局的方向。

paras_en: Weighted index performance over the past six months (source: Bloomberg, as of 2026/07/29).
Nomura analyst view:

Two market noises should not be over‑interpreted. The recent market chatter comes from two sources: first, NVIDIA may provide financing support to OpenAI, raising concerns about cyclical financing and credit risk; second, China’s progress in AI models and domestic DUV equipment, prompting worries that global AI supply‑chain competition will intensify. At this stage, however, NVIDIA’s overall credit risk remains manageable regardless of financing size or corporate profitability, and China’s DUV technology is still in its early development stage, far from wafer‑fab validation, stable mass‑production yields and large‑scale manufacturing. Therefore, the substantive impact of both events on industry fundamentals is relatively limited. In fact, our recent supply‑chain visits show no order cancellations or obvious downgrades for AI‑related orders; semiconductor and key component capacity remains tight, and as long as CSPs continue to expand AI cap‑ex, Taiwan’s supply chain will keep benefiting.
Manager’s perspective:

Bullish factors for the market: (1) Strong AI investment – global tech giants keep raising 2026 cap‑ex, the AI investment cycle has not peaked yet; (2) Asian supply chain remains robust – spec upgrades and shortage‑driven price hikes continue, corporate visibility extends to 2028, benefiting Taiwan’s supply chain; (3) Profit momentum revised upward – Nomura Asset Management’s Taiwan stock pool raises its 2026 full‑year EPS estimate by +64%, continuously ahead of major global markets.

Bearish factors for the market: (1) Leveraged funds are being unwound – as market leverage is reduced and financing maintenance ratios fall to lows, short‑term market volatility remains a risk; (2) Non‑fundamental noise – US‑Iran conflict, inflation pressure, interest‑rate direction and related variables keep pressuring valuation adjustments.
Valuation and position adjustments accelerate, seeking low‑price entry opportunities:

During this wave of heightened market panic and the index’s accelerated bottom‑finding, the weighted index’s forward P/E for the next year has fallen to the three‑year average, erasing earlier concerns that “Taiwan stocks are too expensive.” In contrast to the price decline, corporate earnings continue to be revised upward; Bloomberg’s 2026 Taiwan market profit forecast hit a historic high on 7/28, and Nomura’s July pool also lifted its 2026 full‑year EPS growth to +64%, highlighting the divergence between price and fundamentals. With no sign of earnings slowdown, a continued price drop could push valuations into oversold territory. Such corrections driven by market sentiment and position pressure often present long‑term investors with a chance to re‑allocate. Hence, the current focus is not panic‑buying at lows but planning a positioning strategy for the next rally. Sector‑wise, watch for Vera Rubin spec‑upgrade themes that move into volume production after Q3 with early supply‑chain shipments, and passive components that are expected to see the first notable price hikes in the second half of the year – both are worth tracking for low‑price entry.

items.title: SK海力士暴跌不合理？瑞銀看好AI換代點火、長約護航 目標價看300萬韓元
items.title_en: Is SK Hynix's Plunge Unjustified? UBS Sees AI-Driven Upside, Long-Term Agreements Provide Support, Target Price Cut to 3 Million KRW
paras: 瑞銀發布研究報告指出，SK 海力士 (KR000660)(SKHY-US)   股價自 6 月 22 日高點以來累計下跌 52%，但今年以來仍上漲 115%。該行認為，近期股價大幅修正「並不合理」，目前股價對應預估市淨率僅 1.66 倍，低於公司長期獲利能力所支撐的合理水準。
瑞銀表示，市場及該行對 SK 海力士 2027 年營業利益預估，已分別調升 361% 及 281%，顯示記憶體半導體產業格局已出現重大變化。
該行指出，人工智慧發展將持續推升記憶體需求，預期代理式人工智慧將帶動 2027 年 DRAM 位元需求成長率，由 2026 年的 22% 加快至 36%，NAND 位元需求成長率也將由 20% 升至 23%。
瑞銀指出，SK 海力士推動長期供應協議（LTA）的進度快於預期，目前已簽署 10 份協議，更多合作仍在洽談中，據悉簽約客戶包括美國超大型雲端服務商及大型 OEM 廠商。
該行認為，LTA 雖可能限制短期平均售價（ASP）的上漲空間，但長期有助提升獲利率與報酬率；此外，HBM 方面，2027 年及之後的協商也已有進展。
針對近期營運表現，瑞銀表示，SK 海力士第二季 DRAM 平均售價僅季增 30%，主要受到流動 DRAM 占營收比重升至 19%、部分大型合約採固定價格條款，以及 HBM4 於季末才開始量產等因素影響。
該行因此調升 SK 海力士資本支出預估，2026 年由 45 兆韓元提高至 47 兆韓元，2027 年由 60 兆韓元上調至 62 兆韓元，2028 年則由 63 兆韓元提高至 67 兆韓元。
瑞銀同時下調 SK 海力士第三季營業利益預估至 86 兆韓元，但仍略高於市場預期，主要因假設 LTA 覆蓋率提升，並調整 DRAM 價格預估。
該行也下修 2027 年及 2028 年營業利益預測至 505 兆及 544 兆韓元，分別下調 19% 及 18%，但預期 2026 年至 2028 年自由現金流將分別達 188 兆、320 兆及 374 兆韓元。
瑞銀最後將 SK 海力士目標價由 320 萬韓元下調至 300 萬韓元，但維持「買入」評級，主要基於人工智慧帶動記憶體需求成長，以及公司長期獲利能力仍具支撐。SK
paras_en: UBS released a research report noting that SK Hynix (KR000660) (SKHY‑US) has fallen 52% cumulatively since its June 22 peak, yet it is still up 115% year‑to‑date. The bank argues that the recent sharp price correction “is not justified,” as the current price implies a price‑to‑book ratio of only 1.66×, below the level warranted by the company’s long‑term earnings power.

UBS says that both the market and the bank have raised their 2027 operating‑profit forecasts for SK Hynix, by 361% and 281% respectively, reflecting a major shift in the memory‑semiconductor industry landscape.

The bank points out that the development of artificial intelligence will continue to boost memory demand. It expects AI‑driven demand for DRAM bits to accelerate from a 22% growth rate in 2026 to 36% in 2027, while NAND bit demand growth is projected to rise from 20% to 23%.

UBS notes that SK Hynix’s progress on long‑term supply agreements (LTAs) is ahead of schedule; ten agreements have already been signed and more are under negotiation, reportedly with large U.S. cloud service providers and major OEMs.

While LTAs may limit short‑term average selling‑price (ASP) upside, UBS believes they will enhance profitability and returns over the long run; the bank also says negotiations on HBM for 2027 and beyond are already advancing.

Regarding recent operating performance, UBS reports that SK Hynix’s Q2 DRAM ASP rose only 30% quarter‑over‑quarter, weighed down by a higher share of fluid‑type DRAM in revenue (up to 19%), some large contracts fixed at set prices, and the fact that HBM4 only began volume production at the end of the quarter.

Accordingly, UBS raised its capex outlook for SK Hynix: 2026 capex is increased from 45 trillion KRW to 47 trillion KRW, 2027 from 60 trillion KRW to 62 trillion KRW, and 2028 from 63 trillion KRW to 67 trillion KRW.
UBS also lowered its Q3 operating‑profit estimate to 86 trillion KRW, still slightly above market expectations, mainly due to assumptions of higher LTA coverage and revised DRAM price forecasts.

The bank cut its 2027 and 2028 operating‑profit forecasts to 505 trillion KRW and 544 trillion KRW, down 19% and 18% respectively, but expects free cash flow of 188 trillion KRW, 320 trillion KRW and 374 trillion KRW for 2026‑2028.

Finally, UBS reduced SK Hynix’s target price from 3.2 million KRW to 3.0 million KRW but kept a “Buy” rating, citing AI‑driven memory demand growth and the company’s still‑supportable long‑term profitability.

items.title: 美國加密貨幣立法卡關！川普家族14億美元加密收入掀利益衝突風暴
items.title_en: U.S. Crypto Legislation Stalls as Trump Family’s $1.4 B Crypto Income Sparks Conflict‑of‑Interest Storm
paras: 美國國會夏季休會將至，被加密貨幣產業寄予厚望的《數位資產市場清晰法案》（Clarity Act）能否在剩餘不到一週的時間內闖關成功，如今卻卡在一個意想不到的變數上，即美國總統川普本人。
這部旨在為所有類型加密貨幣建立統一監管架構的法案，原本在川普大力背書下一度前景看好，如今卻因川普家族被揭露自其第二任期以來從加密貨幣生意中進帳高達 14 億美元，而演變成一場關於總統利益衝突的政治風暴。
《清晰法案》6 月 1 日正式排入參議院議程時，市場一度樂觀預期法案將順利過關。過去兩個月，銀行業與執法機關輪番向國會施壓要求修改條文，稅務、開發者保護等爭議也陸續獲得化解，就連過去持保留態度的主要城市警察局長協會，也在 7 月底表態認可最新版本。
然而，隨著美國聯邦政府道德辦公室的一份報告曝光，情勢急轉直下。報告顯示，川普就任第二任期第一年收入暴增 14 億美元，其中多數來自加密貨幣。
他發行的「川普幣」貢獻了 6.35 億美元，而由兩名兒子主導的世界自由金融公司透過治理代幣與穩定幣銷售，則進帳近 8 億美元。
更引發眾怒的是，這筆財富的另一面，是近百萬名散戶投資人的慘重虧損。分析機構 Nansen 的數據顯示，川普幣市值一度衝上近 150 億美元後迅速崩跌，讓大批跟風買進的小額投資人血本無歸。
輿論壓力下，川普被迫同意在法案中加入限制聯邦官員發行加密貨幣的道德條款。但參議院共和黨 7 月 22 日公布的修訂版本，卻被批評留下巨大漏洞：條款雖禁止總統、國會議員等現任官員發行或推廣加密貨幣，且適用於官員配偶，卻獨獨排除了官員子女。
這代表，川普本人最大的兩筆加密貨幣投資，因為都是在他就任總統前啟動（其中一筆甚至在就職前 72 小時才推出），完全不受新規約束；而由他兩個兒子實際掌控的相關事業，同樣遊走在條款之外。
民主黨參議員華倫（Elizabeth Warren）直言，若道德條款無法阻止總統從加密貨幣獲利、也無法防範以此收受賄賂，那根本稱不上是「歷史性突破」。
該草案同時允許川普在過渡期間繼續從加密貨幣投資中獲利，並規定須於一年內將持有資產轉入「盲目信託」。此類信託由獨立受託人管理，受益人不介入資產運作，也無法掌握投資細節，主要用於避免公職人員或企業高層因持有資產而產生利益衝突。

熟悉行業的總統，是助力還是隱憂？

支持者認為，川普及其團隊深諳加密貨幣產業運作，過去一年也確實推動了不少利多政策：設立戰略比特幣儲備、美國數位資產儲備，SEC 自 2025 年 2 月起陸續撤銷對逾十家加密企業的調查與訴訟，加密貨幣市場也隨之走出一波牛市。
這股「內行人主政」的邏輯，曾在 2025 年美國首部穩定幣專法《GENIUS 法案》立法過程中頂住民主黨壓力，順利通過。
但硬幣的另一面，正是外界對利益衝突的疑慮。英國加密貨幣交易信號平台 xBratAI 創辦人 Paul Bratby 表示，一位在任總統若從其政府監管的資產類別中獲利逾 14 億美元，本質上就構成典型的利益衝突，無論主觀意圖為何，這種結構性問題足以動搖公眾對整個監管框架的信任。
他指出，川普持有的資產橫跨迷因幣、NFT、去中心化金融平台乃至挖礦公司股權，幾乎任何監管決策都可能讓他本人受益。
在 Bratby 看來，真正完整的道德框架，除了現行的發行禁令外，還應包括強制揭露官員數位資產持股、要求參與政策制定的官員剝離資產或設立盲目信託、限制官員親屬在監管期間從加密企業獲利，以及建立具獨立執法權的監督機制，而目前的版本，僅觸及其中極小一部分。

立法窗口正在關閉

法律學者孫遠鑷分析，川普及其幕僚牽涉的利益過於龐大，實質退讓的空間有限；而隨著中期選舉逼近不到百日，共和黨與民主黨雙方恐怕都已無意再讓步。
他並指出，最新草案的章節編排方式，透露出法案支持者可能已在盤算退路，將其併入國會 9 月底前必須通過的聯邦預算撥款法案中闖關，但這條路同樣需要跨過不小的支持門檻。
參議院議事日程本就緊繃，且慣例上一次僅處理一項具爭議性的法案。隨著多項內閣提名案審查佔據參院注意力，《清晰法案》被排上表決的機會正持續遭到擠壓。
儘管美國財政部長貝森特 7 月 30 日公開喊話，敦促參院盡快表決，並警告延宕將削弱美國在全球金融科技領域的領先地位，但在缺乏足夠票數保證的情況下，多數黨領袖圖恩也僅表示要「看看票數如何」，未做出明確承諾。
喬治華盛頓大學政治學教授莎拉 · 賓德提醒，歷史經驗顯示，執政黨在中期選舉中幾乎必然流失席次，尤其當總統民調低迷之時。一旦國會焦點徹底轉向選戰,《清晰法案》的前景恐將更加黯淡。
市場人士坦言，若這部法案最終未能闖關，加密貨幣產業實現全面「陽光化」監管的期待，短期內恐怕只能轉而寄望於既有的《GENIUS 法》持續落實，以及 SEC、CFTC 在剩餘任期內釋出的個別利多政策。
paras_en: The U.S. Congress’s summer recess is approaching, and the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act—highly anticipated by the crypto industry—faces an unexpected hurdle: President Donald Trump himself.

The bill, which aims to create a unified regulatory framework for all types of cryptocurrency, was once seen as promising under Trump’s strong endorsement. However, revelations that the Trump family has earned as much as $1.4 billion from crypto ventures since his second term began have turned it into a political storm over presidential conflicts of interest.

When the Clarity Act was placed on the Senate agenda on June 1, the market was optimistic that it would pass smoothly. Over the past two months, banks and law‑enforcement agencies have pressured Congress to amend provisions, and disputes over taxes and developer protections have been resolved. Even the previously cautious major city police chiefs’ association signaled approval of the latest version at the end of July.

But the situation flipped dramatically after a report from the U.S. Office of Government Ethics was released. The report shows that Trump’s income surged by $1.4 billion in the first year of his second term, most of it from crypto assets.
His “Trump Coin” contributed $635 million, while a firm run by his two sons, World Free Finance, earned nearly $800 million through governance token and stablecoin sales.

Even more infuriating, the other side of this wealth is the heavy losses suffered by nearly a million retail investors. Data from analytics firm Nansen shows that Trump Coin’s market cap briefly topped $15 billion before crashing, wiping out many small investors who bought in on the hype.

Under public pressure, Trump agreed to add an ethics clause to the bill that would restrict federal officials from issuing cryptocurrency. However, the Republican‑drafted amendment released on July 22 was criticized for leaving a huge loophole: while it bans sitting presidents, members of Congress and other officials—and their spouses—from issuing or promoting crypto, it expressly excludes their children.

This means Trump’s two largest crypto investments, both launched before he took office (one only 72 hours before inauguration), fall outside the new rules; and the businesses controlled by his sons also remain untouched.
Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren warned that if the ethics clause cannot prevent the president from profiting from crypto or from receiving bribes, it cannot be called a “historic breakthrough.”

The draft also permits Trump to continue profiting from crypto investments during the transition period, requiring him to move the assets into a “blind trust” within a year. Such trusts are managed by independent trustees, with beneficiaries barred from asset management or detailed knowledge, intended to avoid conflicts of interest for public officials or corporate executives.
Is a president familiar with the industry a help or a hidden risk?

Supporters argue that Trump and his team understand crypto operations and have pushed several favorable policies over the past year: establishing a strategic Bitcoin reserve, a U.S. digital‑asset reserve, the SEC’s phased dismissal of investigations and lawsuits against more than ten crypto firms starting February 2025, and a resulting bull market for crypto.
This “insider‑governance” logic helped the 2025 GENIUS Act—the first U.S. stablecoin‑specific law—survive Democratic pressure and pass smoothly.

Nevertheless, critics point to the conflict‑of‑interest concerns. Paul Bratby, founder of the UK crypto‑trading signal platform xBratAI, said that a sitting president profiting over $1.4 billion from assets his administration regulates is a textbook conflict of interest, regardless of intent, and that this structural issue could erode public trust in the entire regulatory framework.
He noted that Trump’s holdings span meme coins, NFTs, DeFi platforms and even mining company equity, meaning virtually any regulatory decision could benefit him personally.

According to Bratby, a truly comprehensive ethics framework should go beyond the current issuance ban to require mandatory disclosure of officials’ digital‑asset holdings, obligate policymakers to divest or place assets in blind trusts, bar relatives from profiting from crypto firms during the regulatory period, and create an independent enforcement mechanism—areas the current draft only scratches lightly.
Legislative window closing

Legal scholar Sun Yuan‑ni argues that Trump and his aides have such extensive stakes that there is little room for genuine concession, and with the mid‑term election less than 100 days away, both parties are unlikely to compromise further.

He also points out that the latest draft’s chapter structure suggests supporters may be planning to bundle the bill into the federal budget appropriation that must pass by the end of September, but that route still faces a high support threshold.

The Senate’s calendar is already tight, and traditionally it handles only one controversial bill at a time. With numerous cabinet nominations occupying attention, the Clarity Act’s chance of a vote continues to be squeezed.

Even though Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen publicly urged the Senate on July 30 to vote quickly and warned that delays would weaken U.S. leadership in global fintech, majority‑party leader Chuck Schumer has only said he will “see how the votes line up,” offering no firm commitment.

George Washington University political science professor Sarah Bender cautions that history shows the governing party almost always loses seats in mid‑terms, especially when the president’s approval is low. If Congress’s focus shifts entirely to the election, the Clarity Act’s outlook could grow even darker.

Market participants admit that if the bill ultimately fails, the crypto industry’s hopes for comprehensive “sunshine” regulation will likely shift in the short term to the continued implementation of the existing GENIUS Act and any individual pro‑crypto measures the SEC or CFTC may roll out before their terms end.

items.title: Moxa推符合IEC 61850-3標準無風扇vPAC伺服器 瞄準變電站環境提升管理效率
items.title_en: Moxa Launches IEC 61850-3 Compliant Fan‑less vPAC Server Aimed at Substation Environments to Boost Management Efficiency
paras: 工業網通廠四零四科技（Moxa）宣布推出電力產業首款符合 IEC 61850-3 標準的變電站級無風扇工業伺服器 DA-920E 系列。作為專為變電站應用環境所打造的新一代無風扇運算平台，可為虛擬保護、自動化與控制（vPAC）架構提供穩定可靠的運算效能，並扮演軟體定義變電站（SDS）的關鍵推手，協助電力業者提升系統靈活性、擴充能力與管理效率，同時強化跨廠牌設備與系統的整合能力。
隨著能源轉型與電網數位化推進，全球電力公司正加速電網現代化並擴大整合再生能源。在離岸風電、併網級太陽能案場與儲能系統蓬勃發展下，電力公司面臨必須以有限人力維運偏遠變電站的挑戰，同時還需兼顧供電可靠度與資安防護需求。
於此同時，變電站保護、自動化與控制（PAC）系統也正從傳統以硬體為核心的架構，逐步邁向以模組化軟體與開放標準為基礎的設計模式。而 vPAC 作為此一轉型的關鍵技術，可將保護、自動化與控制功能部署於共享且具備援能力的虛擬化平台上，不僅提高資源利用效率，也進一步帶動市場對符合 IEC 61850 標準且兼具高可靠性的無風扇 vPAC 伺服器需求。DA-920E 系列正是因應此趨勢而生。
許多現代變電站均採無人值守運作模式，尤其是連接至分散式離岸風電場或偏遠太陽能發電廠的變電站。傳統高效能伺服器多仰賴機械風扇進行散熱，但在高溫且多塵等嚴苛環境中，風扇往往成為最容易故障的元件之一。為此，電力公司和系統營運商正積極尋求方法，因應業界面臨的一大挑戰：如何在提升電網邊緣自動化與智慧化程度的同時，不因此增加營運風險與故障維護的負擔。
Moxa DA-920E 系列採用無風扇被動式散熱設計，透過移除機械式冷卻風扇，大幅降低常見硬體故障風險，進一步提升系統長期運作的穩定性。搭配密封式機殼設計，不僅可有效降低維護需求，更提升整體系統可用性，特別適合部署於沙漠地區、離岸風電場、山區及其他交通不易抵達的變電站環境。

DA-920E 系列經過精心設計，即使在 -25°C 至 55°C 的操作溫度範圍內，仍可維持穩定運算效能，避免因過熱導致 CPU 降頻。產品並提供高效能處理器配置，可滿足 vPAC 及變電站層級應用對運算效能的需求。此外，DA-920E 系列亦能提供電力關鍵任務應用所需的確定性（Deterministic）效能，讓電力業者能夠在虛擬化基礎架構上部署保護與自動化應用，同時維持系統穩定與營運可靠性。
隨著新一代變電站逐步導入在地化決策機制、支援自我修復網路功能，以及邊緣端進階分析應用，無風扇 vPAC 平台已成為支撐上述功能的重要運算基礎，協助電力業者在提升智慧化程度的同時，持續維持電力系統所要求的高可靠度與確定性效能。

DA-920E 系列無風扇 vPAC 伺服器專為 IEC 61850 變電站環境與其他工業認證要求（包括 IEC 60255、IEEE 1613 及 EN 50121-4）而設計，能克服暴露於極端溫度、粉塵、濕氣、振動、電磁干擾及不穩定電力狀況等各種挑戰。藉由 DA-920E 系列，電力業者得以更有信心地將營運範圍擴展至無人值守及偏遠地區的電網邊緣變電站，並將現場部署的邊緣運算平台視為關鍵基礎設施。
隨著 vPAC 解決方案從概念驗證階段邁向現場實際部署，平台可靠度已成為影響軟體定義變電站成功運作的重要關鍵因素。雖然保護與控制功能不再受限於實體智慧型電子設備（IED）的硬體限制，但仍需仰賴強大穩健的運算平台作為基礎，確保其穩定運作。
DA-920E 系列完美結合了無風扇散熱設計、高效能運算能力，以及符合 IEC 61850-3 標準的強固特性，為 vPAC 系統提供穩定可靠的運算基礎，協助電力業者加速推動變電站數位化與現代化的進程。
paras_en: Industrial networking manufacturer 404 Technology (Moxa) announced the launch of the DA-920E series, the first IEC 61850-3‑compliant, fan‑less industrial server for the power sector at substation grade. Built as a next‑generation fan‑less computing platform specifically for substation environments, it delivers stable and reliable performance for virtual protection, automation and control (vPAC) architectures, acts as a key driver for software‑defined substations (SDS), and helps utilities improve system flexibility, scalability and management efficiency while strengthening cross‑vendor equipment and system integration.

As energy transition and grid digitalization accelerate, power companies worldwide are modernizing grids and expanding renewable integration. With offshore wind, grid‑connected solar farms and storage systems booming, utilities face the challenge of maintaining remote substations with limited personnel while also meeting power reliability and cybersecurity requirements.

Meanwhile, substation protection, automation and control (PAC) systems are shifting from hardware‑centric designs toward modular software and open‑standard‑based architectures. vPAC, a pivotal technology in this shift, deploys protection, automation and control functions on shared, resilient virtualized platforms, boosting resource utilization and driving market demand for fan‑less vPAC servers that meet IEC 61850 standards and high reliability. The DA-920E series was created to meet this trend.

Many modern substations operate unattended, especially those linked to dispersed offshore wind farms or remote solar plants. Traditional high‑performance servers rely on mechanical fans for cooling, but in hot, dusty, harsh environments fans are often the most failure‑prone components. Consequently, utilities and system operators are actively seeking ways to address a major industry challenge: how to increase edge grid automation and intelligence without adding operational risk or maintenance burden.

The Moxa DA-920E series uses a fan‑less passive cooling design, eliminating mechanical fans to dramatically reduce common hardware failure risks and further enhance long‑term operational stability. Combined with a sealed enclosure, it not only cuts maintenance needs but also raises overall system availability, making it especially suitable for deployment in desert sites, offshore wind farms, mountainous regions and other hard‑to‑reach substations.

The DA-920E series is meticulously engineered to maintain stable computing performance across an operating temperature range of –25 °C to 55 °C, preventing CPU throttling due to overheating. It offers high‑performance processor options that satisfy the computational demands of vPAC and substation‑level applications. Additionally, the series delivers deterministic performance required for critical power‑task applications, enabling utilities to run protection and automation workloads on virtualized infrastructure while preserving system stability and operational reliability.

As next‑generation substations progressively adopt localized decision‑making, self‑healing network capabilities, and advanced edge analytics, fan‑less vPAC platforms have become essential compute foundations supporting these functions, helping utilities raise intelligence levels while maintaining the high reliability and deterministic performance demanded by power systems.

The DA-920E fan‑less vPAC servers are designed for IEC 61850 substation environments and other industrial certifications—including IEC 60255, IEEE 1613 and EN 50121‑4—enabling them to withstand extreme temperatures, dust, moisture, vibration, electromagnetic interference and unstable power conditions. With the DA-920E series, utilities can confidently extend operations to unattended and remote edge substations, treating the deployed edge computing platform as critical infrastructure.

As vPAC solutions move from proof‑of‑concept to real‑world deployments, platform reliability has become a crucial factor for the successful operation of software‑defined substations. Although protection and control functions are no longer limited by the hardware constraints of physical intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), they still depend on a robust, powerful computing platform as a foundation to ensure stable operation.

The DA-920E series perfectly combines fan‑less cooling, high‑performance computing, and IEC 61850‑3‑compliant ruggedness, providing a stable and reliable compute base for vPAC systems and helping utilities accelerate the digitization and modernization of substations.

items.title: 國航國際燃油附加費8/9起調漲 長程航線調漲211元、短程漲81元
items.title_en: China Airlines International Fuel Surcharge to Increase Starting August 9, Long-Haul Up NT$211, Short-Haul Up NT$81
paras: 因應近期航空燃油價格上漲，交通部民航局今 (3) 日宣布，國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自本 (8) 月 9 日起調漲，短程從 27.5 美元 (約 891 元台幣) 調漲為 30 美元 (約台幣 972 元)，長程航線則從 71.5 美元 (台幣 2316 元) 調漲為 78 美元 (台幣 2527 元)。民航局也已要求國航業者應充分揭露相關資訊，以維護消費者權益。
為維護消費者權益，民航局於 2005 年與國籍航空公司協調客運燃油附加費調整機制，以中油公司公告之國際航空燃油每桶牌價為收取基準，「未達 40 美元」為不收費之第 1 級距，「40 - 未滿 50 美元」為開始收費之第 2 級距，短程航線為 5 美元，長程航線為 13 美元；當油價每增加 10 美元，短程航線增加 2.5 美元，長程航線則增加 6.5 美元。
民航局指出，依據中油今日公告之國際航線航空燃油價格，由每桶 133.29 元調漲為 147.57 美元 (自第 11 級距調整為第 12 級距)，國籍航空公司之國際航線客運燃油附加費短程航線由 27.5 調漲為 30 美元，長程則由 71.5 調漲為 78 美元，自 8 月 9 日起生效。
另民航局也已請國航公司；華航 (2610-TW)、長榮航 (2618-TW)、星宇航空 (2646-TW) 等，應以適當方式揭露相關背景資訊 (如油料成本占總成本比例或計算方式等)，以化解消費者疑慮，旅客亦可洽各航空公司或至其官網查詢相關資訊。
paras_en: In response to recent rises in aviation fuel prices, the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transportation announced today (the 3rd) that the international passenger fuel surcharge for domestic airlines will be increased starting August 9. The short‑haul surcharge will rise from US$27.5 (about NT$891) to US$30 (about NT$972), while the long‑haul surcharge will go from US$71.5 (NT$2,316) to US$78 (NT$2,527). The agency also requires airlines to fully disclose related information to protect consumer rights.

To safeguard consumer interests, the CAAB coordinated with domestic airlines in 2005 to set a fuel surcharge adjustment mechanism based on the per‑barrel price of international aviation fuel announced by CPC Corporation. The first tier (no charge) applies when the price is below US$40, the second tier (charge begins) covers US$40‑<50, with a base surcharge of US$5 for short‑haul routes and US$13 for long‑haul routes. For every US$10 increase in fuel price, the short‑haul surcharge rises by US$2.5 and the long‑haul surcharge by US$6.5.

The CAAB noted that, according to CPC’s latest announcement, the international aviation fuel price rose from NT$133.29 per barrel to US$147.57 per barrel, moving from tier 11 to tier 12. Consequently, domestic airlines’ international passenger fuel surcharge will increase to US$30 for short‑haul and US$78 for long‑haul, effective August 9.

The agency also asked airlines such as China Airlines (2610‑TW), EVA Air (2618‑TW) and Starlux Airlines (2646‑TW) to disclose relevant background information—such as the proportion of fuel cost in total operating costs or the calculation method—in an appropriate manner to alleviate consumer concerns. Travelers can also contact the airlines directly or visit their official websites for details.

items.title: EZWay要收錢、資安有漏？關務署澄清3大誤區：非強制下載、沒收你半毛錢且紙本照收
items.title_en: EZWay Fees and Security Leak? Customs Clarifies Three Misconceptions: No Mandatory Download, No Charges, Paper Receipts Accepted
paras: 財政部關務署今（3）日緊急召開記者會，針對網路流傳關於海關實名認證 App「EZWay（易利委）」具強制性、個資疑慮及向民眾收費等不實訊息，由署長彭英偉親自出面提出三大澄清。他強調，EZWay 是為了取代高風險的紙本委任而生的便利工具，目前已擁有超過 750 萬名用戶，呼籲民眾勿信網路謠言。
針對近期網路上對實名認證制度的誤解，關務署長彭英偉表示，EZWay 的推出初衷是為了保障民眾個資，而非增加負擔。
彭英偉首先提出第一項澄清：「EZWay 從未強制民眾使用」。他指出，民眾進行海外網購報關時，除了使用 App 線上委任，依然可以選擇傳統的紙本委任方式。之所以推行線上化，是因為過去紙本資料容易被不肖業者盜用或重複報關，自 107 年推行至今，已有效降低虛報不法情事，並減少海關的法遵成本。
針對民眾最關心的個資安全問題，彭英偉提出第二項澄清，強調線上系統遠比紙本更具保障。他說明，開發商關貿網路公司不僅通過 ISO 27001 與 ISO 27018 等國際資安認證，更受行政院國家資通安全會報中心的 SOC 監控連通測試。此機制是為了確認進口人與報關行之間的「司法委任關係」，確保每一筆包裹都有明確的授權，防止民眾在不知情的情況下淪為非法物品進口的人頭。
關於「收費」的傳聞，彭英偉則明確闢謠表示，「海關與關貿絕對不會向民眾收費」。目前的服務費用是由關貿公司向使用該系統的「報關行」收取，性質屬於 B2B 的電信加值服務費，每筆費用視市場機制約為 0.8 元至 3.5 元不等，目的是支應系統營運與身分認證的成本，與消費者端的購買成本無直接關係。
彭英偉進一步補充，關貿公司雖有政府持股約 36.1%，但關務署與其並無委託契約關係，EZWay 是由關貿自行建置的工具。只要是具備通關網路經營資格的業者，如「范宇」等，都可以向海關申請建置類似的線上委任平台，市場維持開放競爭，並非外界所傳的壟斷。
目前統計資料顯示，EZWay 的註冊人數已攀升至 759 萬人，在所有進口報關單中，使用線上委任的比例已高達 7 成。彭英偉最後強調，EZWay 是一項保護個資、防範不法、增加通關效率的「三贏」工具，民眾若有疑慮可至官方管道查證，勿輕信網路上的不正確言論。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance’s Customs Administration held an emergency press conference today (the 3rd) to address false online rumors that the customs real‑name authentication app “EZWay” is mandatory, poses personal data risks, and charges users. Director Peng Ying‑wei personally presented three clarifications, emphasizing that EZWay was created as a convenient tool to replace high‑risk paper authorizations, now serving over 7.5 million users, and urging the public not to believe internet rumors.
Regarding recent misunderstandings about the real‑name authentication system, Customs Director Peng said the original purpose of EZWay is to protect citizens’ personal data, not to add burdens.

Peng offered the first clarification: “EZWay has never been mandatory for the public.” He noted that when declaring overseas online purchases, users can still choose the traditional paper authorization method instead of the app’s online delegation. The move to digital was driven by past paper documents being easily misused or duplicated by unscrupulous operators. Since its rollout in 2018, the system has effectively reduced false declarations and lowered customs compliance costs.

Addressing the public’s biggest concern—data security—Peng gave the second clarification, stressing that the online system offers far greater protection than paper. He explained that the developer, Customs Trade Network Co., has obtained international security certifications such as ISO 27001 and ISO 27018, and is subject to SOC monitoring and connectivity testing by the Executive Yuan’s National Cyber‑Security Conference Center. This mechanism verifies the “judicial delegation relationship” between importers and customs brokers, ensuring each parcel has a clear authorization and preventing citizens from unknowingly becoming fronts for illegal imports.

On the rumor of “fees,” Peng categorically denied it, stating, “Customs and Customs Trade will never charge the public.” The current service fee is charged by Customs Trade to the “customs brokers” that use the system, constituting a B2B value‑added telecom service. Each transaction costs roughly NT$0.8 to NT$3.5, depending on market mechanisms, to cover system operation and identity‑verification expenses, and is unrelated to any cost borne by consumers.

Peng added that although the government holds about 36.1% of Customs Trade, the Customs Administration has no outsourcing contract with the company; EZWay is a tool built independently by Customs Trade. Any qualified customs‑network operator, such as “Fan Yu,” can apply to the customs authority to develop a similar online delegation platform, keeping the market open and competitive—not the monopoly alleged by outsiders.

Current statistics show EZWay’s registered users have risen to 7.59 million, and online delegations now account for 70% of all import customs declarations. Peng concluded by emphasizing that EZWay is a “win‑win‑win” tool that protects personal data, deters illegal activity, and improves clearance efficiency. He urged anyone with doubts to verify information through official channels and not to trust inaccurate online statements.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉亞股一枝獨秀 受制月線反壓 漲點收斂至266點收43386點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market After-Hours: A Lone Winner Among Asian Stocks, Held Back by Monthly Trend, Gains Narrow to 266 Points, Closing at 43,386 Points
paras: 台股今 (3) 日在亞股中逆勢上漲，早盤開低後買盤敲進，推升盤中翻紅、最高衝上 43,784 點，上漲超過 650 點，終場漲幅略有收斂，收在 43,386.41 點，上漲 266.66 點，站穩十日線，成交量縮至 8445 億元，與上周五相當。
亞股今日走勢偏弱，日經下跌超過 1%，韓股歷經上周五暴漲後，今日修正超過 5%，其餘包括上海綜合、深圳綜合也全面走跌，僅台股翻紅上漲，在亞股中呈現一枝獨秀。
台股今日終場收紅，上市櫃上漲家數超過 1,200 家，漲幅超過 5% 的達 200 家，下跌家數約 600 家；權值股今日走勢分歧，台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 在上周五罕見漲停後，今日回檔超過 2%，跌破月線大關，市值降至新台幣 61 兆元。
台達電 (2308-TW)、聯電 (2303-TW)(UMC-US) 跌幅皆在 2% 以上，不過，聯發科 (2454-TW)、日月光投控 (3711-TW)、欣興 (3037-TW)、智邦 (2345-TW) 全數亮燈漲停，支撐大盤上漲。
被動元件今日延續強勢反彈走勢，指標股國巨 *(2327-TW)、華新科 (2492-TW) 雙雙漲停，其他如日電貿 (3090-TW)、三集瑞 - KY(6862-TW)、信昌電 (6173-TW)、千如 (3236-TW)、金山電 (8042-TW)、天二科技 (6834-TW) 也同步亮出紅燈，走勢相當凌厲。
儘管台股持續上漲 266.66 點作收，但從技術面來看。今天指數仍受制於月線，上漲近 700 點後收斂漲點，且上檔月線正式下穿季線，季線雖仍維持上揚，但反彈的力道恐將進一步減弱。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market rose against the broader Asian market today (the 3rd). After opening lower, buying pressure pushed the index into the red, peaking at 43,784 points—up more than 650 points. The rally tapered toward the close, ending at 43,386.41 points, a gain of 266.66 points, holding above the 10‑day moving average. Turnover shrank to NT$844.5 billion, roughly the same as last Friday.

Asian markets were generally weak today: Japan's Nikkei fell over 1%, South Korea's KOSPI corrected more than 5% after a sharp rise on Friday, and both the Shanghai Composite and Shenzhen Composite declined across the board. Only Taiwan’s market turned red, standing out as the sole gain among Asian indices.

The Taiwan market closed in the green, with more than 1,200 listed companies posting gains and 200 of them rising over 5%, while about 600 stocks fell. Among the blue‑chip stocks, TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) slipped more than 2% after an unusual limit‑up on Friday, breaking below its monthly moving average and trimming its market value to NT$61 trillion.

Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and United Microelectronics (2303‑TW, UMC‑US) each fell over 2%, but MediaTek (2454‑TW), ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW) and AcBel (2345‑TW) all hit limit‑up, supporting the broader market’s rise.

Passive component stocks continued their strong rebound: sector leaders Guoguang (2327‑TW) and Huaxin Technology (2492‑TW) both hit limit‑up, and others such as Nichia (3090‑TW), KY (6862‑TW), Xin Chang Electric (6173‑TW), Qianru (3236‑TW), Jinshan Electric (8042‑TW) and Tianer Technology (6834‑TW) also flashed green, showing very aggressive moves.

Although the Taiwan index closed with a 266.66‑point gain, technically it remains constrained by the monthly moving average. After climbing nearly 700 points, the rally’s momentum narrowed, and the index’s upper monthly line has now crossed below the quarterly line. While the quarterly line is still trending upward, the rebound’s strength is likely to weaken further.

items.title_en: Nomura Asset Management Taiwan Market Note—Valuation and Position Adjustments Accelerate, Seeking Low‑Price Entry Opportunities
paras: 加權股價指數近 6 個月表現：（資料來源：Bloomberg，截至 2026/07/29）
野村腳勤觀點：
兩項市場雜音，不宜過度解讀

近期市場雜音主要來自兩方面：一是 NVIDIA 可能為 OpenAI 提供融資支持，引發市場對循環融資與信用風險的疑慮；二是中國在 AI 模型及國產 DUV 設備方面取得進展，市場擔心全球 AI 供應鏈競爭加劇。然而就現階段而言，前者 NVIDIA 無論融資規模或企業獲利能力，整體信用風險仍在可控範圍；後者中國 DUV 則仍處於發展初期，距離通過晶圓廠驗證、達到穩定量產良率及大規模生產，仍有相當長的路要走。因此，兩項事件對產業基本面的實質衝擊均相對有限。事實上，以近期我們對供應鏈訪查，AI 相關訂單並未出現取消或明顯下修，半導體與關鍵零組件的產能仍然偏緊，只要 CSP 擴大 AI 資本支出趨勢沒有改變，台灣供應鏈仍將持續受惠。
經理人視角：
大盤利多因素：
（一）AI 投資強勁：全球科技巨頭持續上調 2026 年資本支出，AI 投資循環尚未見頂
（二）亞洲供應鏈續強：規格升級 + 缺貨漲價趨勢延續，企業能見度看至 2028 年，台灣供應鏈持續受惠
（三）獲利動能上修：野村投信台股股票池 2026 全年整體 EPS 預估 + 64%，持續上修並領先全球主要股市
大盤利空因素：
（一）槓桿資金去化中：市場槓桿資金去化，等待融資維持率降至低點，短期股市仍有震盪風險
（二）非基本面雜音干擾：美伊戰事 / 通膨壓力 / 利率方向，相關變數持續為股市帶來估值修正壓力
評價與籌碼加速修正，尋找逢低布局機會

在這波市場恐慌升溫、指數加速趕底的過程中，加權指數未來一年的預期本益比已回落至過去三年平均水準，先前市場認為「台股太貴」的疑慮已經消失。與股價下跌相反的是，企業獲利持續上修，彭博對 2026 年台股整體獲利的預估在 7/28 創下歷史新高，野村投信股票池 7 月最新預估亦將 2026 全年 EPS 成長上調至 + 64%，更加突顯股價與基本面走勢背離的狀況。基本面未見放緩跡象，若股價持續下跌，評價面反而可能逐步進入超跌區間，這類由市場情緒與籌碼壓力所帶來的修正，往往也是長期投資人重新布局好時機。因此，現階段投資重點絕非恐慌殺低，而應開始思考布局策略，為下一波行情預作準備。產業方向上，可優先留意第三季後進入量產、供應鏈提前出貨的 Vera Rubin 規格升級題材，以及下半年可望迎來首波顯著漲價的被動元件，均是值得追蹤並伺機逢低布局的方向。

Nomura analyst view:

Two market noises should not be over‑interpreted. The recent market chatter comes from two sources: first, NVIDIA may provide financing support to OpenAI, raising concerns about cyclical financing and credit risk; second, China’s progress in AI models and domestic DUV equipment, prompting worries that global AI supply‑chain competition will intensify. At this stage, however, NVIDIA’s overall credit risk remains manageable regardless of financing size or corporate profitability, and China’s DUV technology is still in its early development stage, far from wafer‑fab validation, stable mass‑production yields and large‑scale manufacturing. Therefore, the substantive impact of both events on industry fundamentals is relatively limited. In fact, our recent supply‑chain visits show no order cancellations or obvious downgrades for AI‑related orders; semiconductor and key component capacity remains tight, and as long as CSPs continue to expand AI cap‑ex, Taiwan’s supply chain will keep benefiting.
Manager’s perspective:

Bullish factors for the market: (1) Strong AI investment – global tech giants keep raising 2026 cap‑ex, the AI investment cycle has not peaked yet; (2) Asian supply chain remains robust – spec upgrades and shortage‑driven price hikes continue, corporate visibility extends to 2028, benefiting Taiwan’s supply chain; (3) Profit momentum revised upward – Nomura Asset Management’s Taiwan stock pool raises its 2026 full‑year EPS estimate by +64%, continuously ahead of major global markets.

Bearish factors for the market: (1) Leveraged funds are being unwound – as market leverage is reduced and financing maintenance ratios fall to lows, short‑term market volatility remains a risk; (2) Non‑fundamental noise – US‑Iran conflict, inflation pressure, interest‑rate direction and related variables keep pressuring valuation adjustments.
Valuation and position adjustments accelerate, seeking low‑price entry opportunities:

During this wave of heightened market panic and the index’s accelerated bottom‑finding, the weighted index’s forward P/E for the next year has fallen to the three‑year average, erasing earlier concerns that “Taiwan stocks are too expensive.” In contrast to the price decline, corporate earnings continue to be revised upward; Bloomberg’s 2026 Taiwan market profit forecast hit a historic high on 7/28, and Nomura’s July pool also lifted its 2026 full‑year EPS growth to +64%, highlighting the divergence between price and fundamentals. With no sign of earnings slowdown, a continued price drop could push valuations into oversold territory. Such corrections driven by market sentiment and position pressure often present long‑term investors with a chance to re‑allocate. Hence, the current focus is not panic‑buying at lows but planning a positioning strategy for the next rally. Sector‑wise, watch for Vera Rubin spec‑upgrade themes that move into volume production after Q3 with early supply‑chain shipments, and passive components that are expected to see the first notable price hikes in the second half of the year – both are worth tracking for low‑price entry.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉輝達宣布CPO步入量產 激勵光通訊族群多檔亮燈漲停
items.title_en: <Focus Stock> Nvidia Announces CPO Enters Mass Production, Boosting Multiple Optical Communication Stocks to Hit Limit-Up
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 資深副總裁 Gilad Shainer 近期宣告，共同封裝光學 (CPO) 將步入量產，激勵台廠光通訊股今 (3) 日表現強勢，聯亞 (3081-TW)、光聖 (6442-TW)、聯鈞 (3450-TW)、波若威 (3163-TW)、華星光 (4979-TW) 等多檔個股亮燈漲停板。

據外電報導，Gilad Shainer 除了指出 CPO 步入量產，也點名未來光通訊市場最大商機在於垂直擴充 (Scale-up)，所需頻寬效能將會是水平擴充 (Scale-out)10 倍，輝達在任何技術量產前，提前打造好相關供應鏈，從光引擎、封裝、光纖陣列到客製化雷射光源，持續投資及部屬，預期今 (2026) 年可望開始看到大量具備 CPO 技術的交換器，有望在全球各地 AI 工廠中持續導入。
今日盤面上，光通訊族群多檔開盤後，隨即迅速亮燈漲停，聯亞、光聖、聯鈞、波若威、華星光、光環 (3234-TW) 及上詮 (3363 -TW)，其他包括前鼎 (4908-TW)、統新 (6426-TW)、眾達 - KY(4977-TW) 股價也飆漲近 7-8％。
分析師表示，矽光子族群近期完成跌深後打底上揚，加上輝達點名 CPO 將步入量產，儘管外界預期 CPO 放量出貨可能要等到 2028 年，但現在就卡位供應鏈的廠商，有望成為下一波 AI 基礎設施投資的最大受惠者
據研調機構預估也指出，CPO 市場規模將於 2030 年突破 390 億美元，且 2028 至 2029 年間成長動能將隨 Scale-up 開始導入光互連後，市場有望持續增長。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) senior vice president Gilad Shainer recently announced that co-packaged optics (CPO) will move into mass production, spurring strong performance today (the 3rd) among Taiwan's optical communication stocks. Companies such as Lianya (3081-TW), Guangsheng (6442-TW), Lianjun (3450-TW), Borowei (3163-TW) and Huaxingguang (4979-TW) all lit up with limit-up gains.

According to foreign media reports, Shainer not only said CPO is entering mass production, but also identified the biggest future opportunity in the optical communication market as vertical scaling (scale‑up). The required bandwidth performance will be ten times that of horizontal scaling (scale‑out). Nvidia has been building the related supply chain ahead of any technology mass production, from optical engines and packaging to fiber arrays and custom laser sources, continuously investing and deploying. The company expects that in 2026 we will start seeing a large number of switches equipped with CPO technology, which are expected to be widely adopted in AI factories around the world.

On today’s market, many optical communication stocks opened and quickly hit limit‑up. Lianya, Guangsheng, Lianjun, Borowei, Huaxingguang, Guanghuan (3234‑TW) and Shangquan (3363‑TW) surged, while others including Qian Ding (4908‑TW), Tongxin (6426‑TW) and Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW) also jumped about 7‑8%.

Analysts say the silicon photonics sector has recently recovered after a deep decline, and Nvidia’s announcement that CPO will enter mass production adds further upside. Although the market expects large‑scale CPO shipments may not materialize until 2028, companies that have already positioned themselves in the supply chain are likely to be the biggest beneficiaries of the next wave of AI infrastructure investment.

Research firms estimate the CPO market will exceed $39 billion by 2030, and that growth momentum from 2028 to 2029 will accelerate as scale‑up drives the adoption of optical interconnects, sustaining market expansion.

items.title: 高資產客戶破1500人發威！彰銀上半年獲利及EPS改寫同期高 看好年底前AUM再攀高
items.title_en: High-Net-Worth Clients Surpass 1,500, Driving Growth! Chang Hwa Bank Posts Record H1 Profit and EPS, Outlook Positive for AUM Rise Before Year-End
paras: 在亞資中心政策帶動下，截至今年 5 月底，國內銀行端「財管 2.0」高資產業務規模「倍增」至 2.7 兆，客戶數達 2.5 萬人，彰化銀行（2801-TW）受惠高資產財富管理業務動能爆發，今年上半年繳出亮眼成績單，累計前 6 個月合併稅後盈餘達 113.14 億元，每股稅後盈餘（EPS）0.94 元，雙創同期最佳紀錄。彰銀過去一年鎖定精進結構、強化成長動能，成功提升海外獲利及財富管理手續費收入，看好年底前國內高資產戶數與資產管理規模（AUM）將持續成長。
彰銀配合政府推動「亞洲資產管理中心」政策，積極布局高資產財富管理市場，整合投資理財、家族辦公室、信託規劃、資產傳承及跨境金融等專業服務，打造一站式財富管理平台。
彰銀自 107 年成立高資產服務團隊以來，已累積服務逾 1,500 位高資產客戶，整合市場研究、投資策略、稅務規劃、保險、信託、傳承及資產配置等跨領域專業，提供客製化財富管理方案。彰銀財管顧問團隊目前已達 500 人，今年預計再增聘 40 名財管專業人才，持續擴大服務量能。
在高資產業務版圖方面，彰銀自 114 年 10 月開辦高資產業務以來穩步擴張，並於今年 3 月 26 日正式啟動「亞資中心高雄專區分行」服務，以「槓桿優化」與「家族傳承」為核心，提供結合稅務規劃的保費融資、信託受益權擔保質借及家族辦公室服務。
彰銀預期至 115 年底，高資產戶數與資產管理規模（AUM）將持續成長，進一步提升市場競爭優勢。在整體亞資中心政策帶動下，截至今年 5 月底，國內銀行端「財管 2.0」高資產業務規模已倍數成長至 2.7 兆元，客戶數達 2.5 萬人，彰銀可望受惠產業成長趨勢。
在投資理財服務方面，彰銀依據客戶風險屬性、投資目標及資產配置需求，提供多元金融商品配置建議，涵蓋國內外基金、債券、結構型商品、外國股票及保險等商品，並落實投資適配性管理及風險控管機制。
此外，彰銀歷年舉辦逾百場高資產客戶講座活動，推動家族財富管理服務，透過信託架構、資產傳承規劃、稅務諮詢及企業接班等整合性方案，協助高資產客戶妥善安排家庭財富永續傳承。今年 8 月，彰銀將於全台舉辦五場高資產客戶講座，結合高資產服務團隊及外部專家顧問，提供跨世代財富管理服務。
彰銀表示，高資產財富管理不僅著重資產規模的成長，更重視與客戶建立長期且值得信賴的夥伴關係，未來將持續秉持「熱忱、效率、創新」的經營理念，深化數位金融應用，結合跨境金融與在地服務優勢，打造兼具國際視野與專業特色的高資產財富管理平台，協助客戶創造財富價值。
paras_en: Driven by the Asian Asset Management Center policy, domestic banks' "Wealth Management 2.0" high‑net‑worth (HNW) business scale has doubled to NT$2.7 trillion as of the end of May, serving 25,000 clients. Benefiting from the surge in HNW wealth‑management demand, Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) delivered an impressive first‑half performance, posting a consolidated after‑tax profit of NT$11.314 billion and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.94 – the best record in the bank’s history for the same period.

In line with the government’s push for an "Asian Asset Management Center," Chang Hwa Bank is actively positioning itself in the HNW wealth‑management market, integrating investment advisory, family office, trust planning, wealth succession and cross‑border finance services to create a one‑stop wealth‑management platform.

Since establishing its HNW service team in 2018 (Year 107 of the ROC calendar), the bank has served more than 1,500 HNW clients, offering cross‑disciplinary expertise in market research, investment strategy, tax planning, insurance, trusts, succession and asset allocation to deliver customized wealth‑management solutions. The wealth‑management advisory team now numbers 500 professionals, and the bank plans to hire an additional 40 specialists this year to further expand capacity.

Regarding its HNW business footprint, Chang Hwa Bank has steadily expanded since launching the HNW segment in October 2025 (Year 114). On March 26 this year it officially opened the “Asian Asset Management Center Kaohsiung Branch,” focusing on "leverage optimization" and "family succession" and offering premium‑financing tied to tax planning, trust‑beneficiary‑secured loans, and family‑office services.

The bank expects the number of HNW clients and assets under management (AUM) to keep growing through the end of 2026 (Year 115), strengthening its competitive edge. Under the broader Asian Asset Management Center policy, domestic banks' "Wealth Management 2.0" HNW business has multiplied to NT$2.7 trillion with 25,000 clients as of May, positioning Chang Hwa to benefit from this industry‑wide growth trend.

In its investment‑advisory services, Chang Hwa tailors product recommendations to each client’s risk profile, investment goals and asset‑allocation needs, covering domestic and overseas funds, bonds, structured products, foreign equities and insurance, while implementing suitability management and risk‑control mechanisms.

The bank has hosted more than a hundred seminars for HNW clients over the years, promoting family‑wealth management through integrated solutions such as trust structures, succession planning, tax consulting and business succession. In August, Chang Hwa will hold five HNW client seminars nationwide, featuring its HNW service team and external expert advisors to provide cross‑generational wealth‑management services.

Chang Hwa emphasizes that HNW wealth management is not only about growing asset size but also about building long‑term, trustworthy partnerships. Going forward, the bank will continue to uphold its "passion, efficiency, innovation" philosophy, deepen digital‑finance applications, combine cross‑border finance with local service strengths, and create a high‑net‑worth wealth‑management platform with both international perspective and professional distinction to help clients generate wealth value.

items.title: 國際廢鋼走勢拉鋸下游觀望 豐興鋼筋連二周平盤
items.title_en: International Scrap Steel Tugs-of-War Leaves Downstream Cautious; Fengxing Rebar Flat for Two Weeks
paras: 鋼筋廠豐興 (2015-TW) 今 (3) 日開出本周盤價，由於國際廢鋼走勢拉鋸、國內下游持續觀望，廢鋼收購價、鋼筋盤價連續二周開出平盤。
國際原料一周行情來看，美國大船廢鋼無報價，日本 2H 廢鋼持平每公噸 350 美元，美國貨櫃廢鋼同樣持平每公噸 330 美元，澳洲鐵礦砂由每公噸 98.9 美元跌至 96.55 美元。
豐興說明，國際廢鋼雖然先前走跌一小段，但目前買盤仍高盤不起，因此呈現拉鋸，是否能築底還有待觀察，在此氛圍下，國內下游也持續縮手觀望，因此盤價以平盤開出。
目前豐興盤價，廢鋼收購價為每公噸 9200 元、鋼筋每公噸 1.78 萬元，型鋼基價同樣維持平盤每公噸 2.5 萬元。
paras_en: Rebar manufacturer Fengxing (2015‑TW) posted this week’s market prices today (3rd). Amid a tug‑of‑war in international scrap‑steel trends and continued hesitation from domestic downstream users, both scrap‑steel purchase prices and rebar market prices have opened flat for the second consecutive week.

Looking at the week’s international raw‑material market, there were no quotes for large‑ship U.S. scrap steel, Japanese H2 scrap steel remained steady at $350 per metric ton, U.S. container scrap steel also held steady at $330 per metric ton, and Australian iron ore fell from $98.90 to $96.55 per metric ton.

Fengxing explained that although international scrap steel had previously slipped a bit, buying interest is still unable to push prices higher, resulting in a back‑and‑forth situation. Whether a bottom is forming remains to be seen. In this atmosphere, domestic downstream players continue to scale back and watch, so the market price was set flat.
Currently, Fengxing’s market prices are: scrap‑steel purchase price NT$9,200 per metric ton, rebar NT$17,800 per metric ton, and structural steel base price also flat at NT$25,000 per metric ton.

items.title: 繼Kimi K3後又一家參數破兩兆！阿里發布新一代AI模型千問3.8-MAX  股價勁揚逾7%
items.title_en: After Kimi K3, Another Model Breaks the 2‑Trillion Parameter Barrier! Alibaba Launches Next‑Gen AI Model Qwen 3.8‑MAX, Stock Soars Over 7%
paras: 阿里巴巴今 (3) 日在港股早盤大漲超過 7%，午後續揚，一度漲高至每股 126 港元，主要因為阿里巴巴正式發布新一代基座大模型 Qwen3.8，總參數量 2.4 兆，在 Coding 和專業辦公 (Cowork) 方面能力大幅提升，繼 Kimi K3 之後，成為最新一個參數突破兩兆的國產大模型。
在今日放榜的權威三方榜單 Arena 中，Qwen 3.8 僅次於 Anthropic 的 Claude 系列，整體表現處於全球大模型第一梯隊。
目前，Qwen3.8 的 API 已上線千問 AI 平台，並接上阿里巴巴今日同步推出的 Agent 產品「千問辦公」。Qwen3.8-Max 預計下週開源，同時也將開源 Qwen3.8-27B。
據了解，阿里真武 M890 超節點也成功適應 Qwen3.8，透過晶片、雲端平台與千問大模型的全鏈條優化，顯著提升推理效率、降低推理成本，在 Agentic 推理場景中最多可實現 1.5 倍效能提升。
值得注意的是，阿里巴巴今日也宣佈公測企業級 Agent 產品「千問辦公」，用戶可在該產品體驗 Qwen3.8，而新的「千問辦公」由 QoderWork、MuleRun、悟空三款產品全面整合而來，是業內首款同時支援桌面端 Agent、雲端 Agent、企業協同 Agent 的產品，已初步打通了釘釘 IM，未來將全面連接企業真實的資料庫和工作流程，幫助企業提效。
今日起，全球開發者可透過千問 AI 平台取得 Qwen3.8 的 API 服務，中國國內每百萬 Tokens 輸入價格人民幣 12 元、輸出 36 元，隱式快取命中僅 1.5 元，而輸入與輸出的國際價格僅為 Opus5 的 40% 與 24%。
paras_en: Alibaba saw its Hong Kong shares surge more than 7% in early trading on the 3rd, and continue to rise in the afternoon, peaking at HK$126 per share. The jump was driven by the official launch of its next‑generation foundation model Qwen 3.8, which packs 2.4 trillion parameters and delivers markedly stronger performance in coding and professional office (Cowork) tasks. Following the Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8 becomes the latest domestic large model to break the two‑trillion‑parameter mark.
In today’s authoritative three‑party ranking from Arena, Qwen 3.8 ranks just behind Anthropic’s Claude series, placing it in the top tier of global large models.

The Qwen 3.8 API is already live on the Qianwen AI platform and is integrated with Alibaba’s newly released Agent product “Qianwen Office”. Qwen 3.8‑MAX is slated to be open‑sourced next week, along with the 27‑billion‑parameter version Qwen 3.8‑27B.

According to sources, Alibaba’s Zhenwu M890 ultra‑node has successfully adapted to Qwen 3.8. Through full‑stack optimisation of the chip, cloud platform and the Qianwen large model, inference efficiency is significantly improved and inference cost reduced, delivering up to a 1.5× performance boost in agentic inference scenarios.

Alibaba also announced the public beta of its enterprise‑grade Agent product “Qianwen Office”. Users can experience Qwen 3.8 within the product. The new “Qianwen Office” integrates three offerings—QoderWork, MuleRun and Wukong—making it the industry’s first solution that supports desktop agents, cloud agents and enterprise‑collaboration agents simultaneously. It has already achieved preliminary integration with DingTalk IM and will later connect fully to corporate databases and workflows to boost enterprise productivity.

Starting today, developers worldwide can obtain Qwen 3.8 API services via the Qianwen AI platform. In mainland China the price is RMB 12 per million input tokens and RMB 36 per million output tokens, with an implicit cache‑hit cost of only RMB 1.5. International pricing for input and output is just 40% and 24% of Opus5’s rates, respectively.

items.title: 長鑫科技納入DRAM ETF！躍居第八大持股、占比達2.52%
items.title_en: ChangXin Technology Added to DRAM ETF, Rises to 8th Largest Holding at 2.52%
paras: 全球第一檔以記憶體晶片為主題的 ETF Roundhill DRAM ETF(DRAM-US) ，於七月底完成最新一輪成分股調整，將中國記憶體廠長鑫科技 (688825-CN) 納入持倉，占比達 2.52%，躋身該基金第八大重倉股。
相對地，同樣來自中國的兆易創新 (603986-CN) 則在此次調整中權重下滑至 1.51%，排名滑落至第十大持股。
回顧兆易創新於 2026 年 6 月首度被 DRAM ETF 納入時，權重曾高達 2.91%，同樣位居第八大重倉股之列。
DRAM ETF 由 Roundhill Investments 發行，於 2026 年 4 月 2 日在美國 Cboe BZX 交易所掛牌，是全球首檔聚焦純記憶體晶片產業的交易所買賣基金，一推出便吸引市場高度關注。
根據截至 8 月 2 日的最新資料，該基金前三大持倉依序為三星電子 (005930KS) 、美光科技 (MU-US) 與 SK 海力士 (000660KS) ，權重分別為 26.39%、24.54% 及 22.77%，三大廠合計占比超過 70%。
值得注意的是，Roundhill 上週同步調節了三星電子的持股部位，週一至週三連續三個交易日各減碼約 100 萬股，三日合計拋售 300 萬股，出售金額約達 4.32 億美元。
從整體持倉結構來看，DRAM ETF 目前前十大重倉股涵蓋三星電子、美光科技、SK 海力士、希捷科技 (STX-US) 、威騰電子 (WDC-US) 、SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 、鎧俠，以及長鑫科技、南亞科 (2408-TW) 與兆易創新，幾乎囊括全球主要記憶體晶片廠商。
其中，長鑫科技被視為中國規模最大、研發與製造一體化程度最高的 DRAM 廠商。根據市場研究機構 Omdia 針對 2025 年第四季銷售額的統計推算，長鑫科技全球市占率已達 7.67%，位居全球第四、中國業者之首。
paras_en: The world’s first memory‑chip‑focused ETF, the Roundhill DRAM ETF (DRAM-US), completed its latest round of constituent adjustments at the end of July, adding China‑based memory manufacturer ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) to its portfolio at a weight of 2.52%, making it the fund’s eighth‑largest position.
Conversely, another Chinese company, Zhaoyi Innovation (603986-CN), saw its weight fall to 1.51% in this adjustment, slipping to the fund’s tenth‑largest holding.
When Zhaoyi Innovation was first added to the DRAM ETF in June 2026, its weight had peaked at 2.91%, also ranking as the eighth‑largest position at that time.

The DRAM ETF, issued by Roundhill Investments, was listed on the Cboe BZX exchange in the United States on April 2, 2026. It is the world’s first exchange‑traded fund dedicated solely to the pure memory‑chip industry and attracted strong market attention upon launch.

According to the latest data as of August 2, the fund’s top three holdings are Samsung Electronics (005930KS), Micron Technology (MU-US) and SK Hynix (000660KS), with weights of 26.39%, 24.54% and 22.77% respectively, together accounting for over 70% of the portfolio.

Notably, Roundhill also adjusted its Samsung position last week, reducing roughly 1 million shares each day from Monday through Wednesday, for a total sale of about 3 million shares valued at approximately $432 million.

Looking at the overall holdings, the DRAM ETF’s current top ten positions include Samsung Electronics, Micron Technology, SK Hynix, Seagate Technology (STX-US), Western Digital (WDC-US), SanDisk (SNDKV-US), Kioxia, as well as ChangXin Technology, Nanya Technology (2408-TW) and Zhaoyi Innovation, covering virtually all major global memory‑chip manufacturers.

ChangXin Technology is regarded as China’s largest DRAM maker with the most integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities. Based on Omdia’s market‑share estimate for Q4 2025, ChangXin holds a global DRAM market share of 7.67%, ranking fourth worldwide and first among Chinese firms.

items.title: AI能否回本？微軟、亞馬遜、Alphabet財報揭示華爾街「新邏輯」
items.title_en: Can AI Turn a Profit? Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet Earnings Reveal Wall Street’s “New Logic”
paras: 人工智慧（AI）狂潮進入下一階段，華爾街的評價標準正快速改變。最新一輪科技股財報顯示，市場已不再只看企業投入多少資本建設 AI，而是更關注誰能率先將龐大投資轉化為營收、獲利與現金流。隨著雲端巨頭們交出亮眼成績單，雲端運算正被視為 AI 最成熟的變現模式；相較之下，缺乏雲端獲利引擎的企業則面臨更嚴格檢驗，代表 AI 投資的焦點正從「燒錢」轉向「賺錢」。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 財報公布後股價單日暴衝逾 13%，全週累計漲幅達 19%，股價從 389 美元一舉衝上 460 美元大關；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 同期同樣強勢，漲幅超過 15%，由 231 美元推升至 271 美元。
AlphabetGOOGL-US) 也不遑多讓，全週上漲 7%，股價自 326 美元漲至 356 美元，市場重新看待其雲端業務加速成長背後所隱含的 AI 變現價值；甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 則同樣受惠於雲端業務的樂觀預期，週漲幅同樣突破 10%。
然而，這波行情並非「見 AI 就買」的無腦追捧。同樣重押 AI 基礎建設的 Meta(META-US) ，上週股價卻逆勢下跌 6%，從 593 美元滑落至 556 美元；身為 AI 算力核心供應商的輝達 (NVDA-US) ，全週漲幅僅 2%，股價在 195 至 200 美元區間原地打轉，市場正屏息等待其 8 月 26 日財報。
換言之，華爾街的邏輯正在收斂成一句話：重點不再是誰砸的錢多，而是誰能把砸下去的錢，變回實實在在的營收、獲利與現金流。

雲端業務全面開花，AI「變現故事」逐漸成形

分析指出，科技巨頭最新一季財報透露出一個清晰訊號：AI 投資正從燒錢的資本支出階段，邁入開始收成的收入兌現期。
亞馬遜 AWS、微軟 Azure 與 Alphabet 旗下雲端業務，本季營收全數大幅優於市場預期。AWS 營收年增 37%，Azure 年增更高達 43%，三大雲端業務合計成長率達 48%。
分析人士認為，在 AI 商業模式仍眾說紛紜之際，雲端運算已成為目前最容易被驗證、也最具說服力的獲利路徑。
科技巨頭透過興建資料中心、採購晶片與運算設備，再以長期合約方式將算力出租給企業客戶，完成從基礎建設投入到現金流回收的完整循環。
其中，AWS 本季營業利益率達到 39% 的水準。執行長 Andy Jassy 透露，公司運算設備平均約三年即可回本，而 AI 相關運算合約的年限多數超過五年，代表目前的投資能享有相對長期且穩定的獲利兌現週期。
Jassy 指出：「由此而來的營收、自由現金流與資本報酬率，非常有說服力。」他並拋出 AWS 未來有機會成長為年營收上看 1 兆美元業務的長遠願景。
相較之下，據 FactSet 統計，分析師目前預估 AWS 今年營收約為 1700 億美元。
驅動這股雲端熱潮的核心動能，正是 AI 需求本身。整個產業的瓶頸，已從過去的「有沒有需求」，轉變為現在的「算力夠不夠用」。
今年 4 月，AWS 與 Anthropic 簽下一筆金額超過 1000 億美元、為期十年的合作協議，正是這股 AI 算力搶購潮的具體縮影。
值得注意的是，相較於微軟、亞馬遜與 Alphabet 三巨頭，Meta 這次面對的市場考驗顯然更為嚴峻。
這家社群媒體巨擘同樣在 AI 基礎建設上砸下重金，卻缺乏成熟的雲端事業體，無法像 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud 那樣，直接透過對外出租算力來創造營收回報。
財報公布至今，Meta 股價已累計下跌約 5%。儘管公司先前已上修 2026 年資本支出預估，執行長祖克柏也表示正考慮建立自家雲端業務，但坦言目前進度仍大幅落後三大雲端龍頭。
分析稱，華爾街的評分標準正日趨明確，即 AI 投資能否成功，關鍵不在於砸錢的規模，而在於企業是否具備能把資本支出轉化為長期穩定現金流的商業模式。
與此同時，雲端運算似乎已經成為市場公認最成熟的解答，而缺乏這條變現路徑的公司，正面臨愈來愈嚴格的檢視眼光。

下一關考驗：獲利的「含金量」

儘管本季科技巨頭整體獲利表現強勁，市場對財報的反應卻明顯分歧。
根據高盛統計，在科技、媒體與電信（TMT）類股中，每股盈餘優於預期的公司，公布財報隔日平均反而落後標普 500 指數約 192 個基點；相對地，非 TMT 類股中同樣繳出優於預期成績單的公司，隔日平均卻能跑贏大盤約 75 個基點。
這樣的反差說明，市場對科技股的定價邏輯正在轉變。投資人不再只看短期業績是否「超標」，而是更在意獲利成長能否持續、以及獲利究竟從何而來。
第二季，標普 500 整體 EPS 年增率追蹤值高達 45%，但其中約 19 個百分點，其實來自 Alphabet 與亞馬遜合計約 1510 億美元的股權投資「其他收入」挹注，微軟則另外貢獻約 30 億美元。若剔除這類非經常性因素，核心獲利成長仍達 26%，是 2021 年以來最快的成長速度。
目前，AI 基礎建設相關企業已貢獻標普 500 本季 EPS 成長的近三分之一。分析師預期，到了 2026 年下半年至 2027 年，這個占比可能會進一步突破 50%。
不過，成本壓力仍是不容忽視的隱憂。過去幾季，標普 500 成分股中位數公司的淨利率已呈現停滯，多數產業的未來利潤率預期也遭到下修。
高盛目前仍維持標普 500 指數年底目標點位 8000 點的看法，並預估 2027 年標普 500 每股盈餘可達 385 美元。
分析總結稱，對這波 AI 行情而言，市場關注焦點接下來將從「資本支出的速度」，逐漸轉向「獲利成長能否持續」的更深層考驗。
paras_en: The AI frenzy is entering its next phase, and Wall Street’s evaluation standards are shifting rapidly. The latest round of tech earnings shows the market no longer only looks at how much capital a company pours into building AI, but focuses more on who can be the first to turn massive investments into revenue, profit, and cash flow. As cloud giants deliver impressive results, cloud computing is being seen as the most mature AI monetization model; by contrast, companies lacking a cloud profit engine face stricter scrutiny, indicating that AI investment focus is moving from "burning cash" to "making money."

After Microsoft (MSFT-US) reported earnings, its stock surged more than 13% in a single day and rose 19% for the week, jumping from $389 to breach the $460 mark. Amazon (AMZN-US) was similarly strong, gaining over 15% and climbing from $231 to $271.

Alphabet (GOOGL-US) also performed well, up 7% for the week as its stock rose from $326 to $356, with the market re‑evaluating the AI monetization value hidden behind accelerated growth in its cloud business. Oracle (ORCL-US) likewise benefited from optimistic cloud expectations, posting a weekly gain of over 10%.

However, this rally is not a mindless "buy anything AI" frenzy. Meta (META-US), which also heavily bets on AI infrastructure, saw its stock fall 6% last week, sliding from $593 to $556. Nvidia (NVDA-US), a core AI compute supplier, posted a modest 2% weekly gain, with its share price hovering between $195 and $200 as the market awaits its earnings on August 26.
In other words, Wall Street’s logic is converging on a single point: the focus is no longer on who spends the most, but on who can turn that spending into real revenue, profit, and cash flow.

Cloud businesses are blooming across the board, and AI’s "monetization story" is taking shape. Analysts note that the latest quarterly reports from tech giants send a clear signal: AI investment is moving from a cash‑burning capital‑expenditure phase into a revenue‑realization period.

Amazon’s AWS, Microsoft’s Azure, and Alphabet’s cloud services all posted revenues this quarter that far exceeded market expectations. AWS revenue grew 37% year‑over‑year, Azure grew an even higher 43%, and the three major cloud businesses together posted a combined growth rate of 48%.

Analysts believe that while AI business models are still debated, cloud computing has become the most verifiable and persuasive profit path today. Tech giants build data centers, purchase chips and compute equipment, and then lease compute capacity to enterprise customers via long‑term contracts, completing a full cycle from infrastructure investment to cash‑flow recovery.

AWS achieved an operating margin of 39% this quarter. CEO Andy Jassy said the company’s compute equipment typically pays back in about three years, and most AI‑related compute contracts run longer than five years, meaning current investments enjoy a relatively long and stable profit realization cycle.

Jassy added, "The resulting revenue, free cash flow, and return on capital are very compelling," and he floated a long‑term vision of AWS eventually becoming a $1 trillion‑a‑year revenue business.
